units.source_text: 且说内大臣看见别人准备女儿入宫，排场如此盛大，

en.t: Now, when the Minister of the Interior saw others preparing their daughters to enter the palace with such grand ceremony,

units.source_text: 回想自家女儿，觉得十分懊丧。

en.t: he thought back to his own daughter and felt deeply disheartened.

units.source_text: 他家那位云居雁小姐，芳龄已届二十，

en.t: His daughter, Lady Kumoi no Kari, had already reached the age of twenty,

units.source_text: 美貌如花似玉，而空闺独守，

en.t: and though she was as beautiful as flowers and jewels, she remained alone in an empty chamber,

units.source_text: 寂寞无聊。

en.t: lonely and with nothing to console her.

units.source_text: 为父亲的着实替她担心。

en.t: As her father, he was truly worried for her.

units.source_text: 那个夕雾呢，

en.t: As for that Yugiri,

units.source_text: 态度和从前一样冷淡，

en.t: his manner remained as cool as ever,

units.source_text: 毫无热情表示。

en.t: and he showed no sign of passion at all.

units.source_text: 若教这边让步，主动向他求婚，

en.t: If they were to yield on their side and take the initiative in proposing to him,

units.source_text: 又恐被人耻笑。

en.t: they feared they would be laughed at by others.

units.source_text: 因此内大臣独自悲叹，

en.t: Thus the Minister of the Interior grieved and sighed alone,

units.source_text: 悔不当夕雾热心求爱之时答应了他。

en.t: regretting that he had not accepted Yugiri when he had so earnestly sought her love.

units.source_text: 他仔细想来，

en.t: When he thought it over carefully,

units.source_text: 此事不能归罪于夕雾一人身上。

en.t: he realized that the blame for this matter could not be placed on Yugiri alone.

units.source_text: 内大臣后悔之事，夕雾亦有所闻。

en.t: Yugiri also heard something of the Minister of the Interior's regret.

units.source_text: 但他回想内大臣对他的冷酷，

en.t: But when he remembered how coldly the Minister of the Interior had treated him,

units.source_text: 心中犹有余恨，

en.t: some resentment still lingered in his heart,

units.source_text: 因此故意装作镇静，

en.t: and so he deliberately pretended to be calm,

units.source_text: 不肯前去求婚。

en.t: refusing to go and ask for her hand.

units.source_text: 然而他决不是另外爱上了别的女人。

en.t: Yet it was certainly not that he had fallen in love with some other woman.

units.source_text: 他真心恋慕云居雁，

en.t: He truly loved Kumoi no Kari,

units.source_text: 常有“暂别心如焚，方知戏不得”之叹。

en.t: and often sighed that even a brief parting set his heart aflame and taught him this was no mere game.

units.source_text: 然而云居雁的乳母曾经嘲笑他的淡绿袍，

en.t: However, Kumoi no Kari's nurse had once mocked his pale green robe,

units.source_text: 因此他打定主意：

en.t: and because of that he made up his mind:

units.source_text: 等到升了纳言，

en.t: he would wait until he was promoted to Counselor,

units.source_text: 换上红袍之后再去求见。

en.t: then change into a red robe and go to seek an audience with her.
